description: Nexora KPI Card is a premium single-value visual built for clarity and for Arabic-first reporting. It displays your most important metric with an elegant, responsive number that scales to fit, alongside optional comparison values, progress rings, trend sparklines, and target bars. Key features: - Native right-to-left (RTL) layout and full Arabic support, with seamless English (LTR) handling. - Built-in currency formatting including the official Saudi Riyal symbol, plus percentages and 11 currencies. - Compare against a target or a previous period, with an automatic change indicator (▲/▼). - Optional progress ring, trend sparkline, and "vs target" bar — one card, many layouts. - Auto-fit number that stays crisp at any card size. - Rich font controls that inherit your report theme by default. - Clean, modern design with a refined color palette. Nexora KPI Card is completely free, with no license, watermark, or trial limits. It is part of the Nexora suite of Arabic-first analytics visuals.
